['build a Parlai agent that uses litellm to query OpenAI chat completions with configurable model and temperature', 'create command line arguments for configuring OpenAI chat completion model name, max tokens, and temperature', 'test the OpenaiChatCompletionsAgent act method to generate a response from the last observation', 'refactor the query_chat_completion_api method to add retry logic or custom headers for litellm calls', 'review the FakeHistory class and its add_reply and get_history_str methods for conversation turn tracking']
